name: Shambling Zombie
description: An animated corpse that moves shakily, driven only by hunger.

abilities.name: Too Many to Handle
abilities.description: When the Zombie is within Melee range of a creature and at least one other Zombie is within Close range, all attacks against that creature have advantage.

abilities.name: Horrifying
abilities.description: Targets who mark HP from the Zombie’s attacks must also mark a Stress.
